card.name: Heritage and traditional culture contexts
card.fires_on: The word "traditional" itself, and small linking words just before where "traditional" could come next. Settings are cultural heritage, national customs, folk culture, cuisine and old buildings.

modes.label: The word traditional
modes.description: The word Traditional or traditional in heritage or national-culture phrases.
modes.example: Poppy seed is part of the<< traditional>> Hungarian cuisine.

modes.label: Linking word before culture terms
modes.description: A small word or comma after culture, origin or a country description, where a word like traditional could follow.
modes.example: the maintenance of its language, culture<<,>> and religion were specifically written into the Constitution

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying "traditional" or the Chinese words for tradition, and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It lights up in texts about heritage and national customs, where the word "traditional" is likely to come up.
